about: Conformance vectors for the mythos.effect-reconciliation/v1 receipt: the signed answer of one provider readback about a dispatch whose effect was unknown, generated from achilles-engine (achilles/observed_effect.py: reconciliation_document, sign_reconciliation) and carried byte for byte in athena-backend. Every valid case verified, and every invalid case was refused, by Achilles' own verify_reconciliation / validate_reconciliation when this file was written; achilles_refusal records Achilles' words. Keys, payloads and signatures are written as hex (payload_hex, sig_hex): an envelope's base64 fields are the base64 of those bytes; a field that is not base64 at all is written as posted. Each key is Ed25519 with the private seed SHA-256 of its phrase: test keys, public by construction, never a real one.
effect_key_phrase: mythos.effect-reconciliation/v1 conformance vector: the observed-effect test key, never a real one
gate_key_phrase: mythos.effect-reconciliation/v1 conformance vector: the gate's outcome test key, never a real one
